🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals with Real Estate/Utilities strength while Technology and Financials show notable weakness; leadership concentration narrow (Top 5: 3/5 Real Estate).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate lead: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities and Materials follow: EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND. Financials lag: BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION and WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND; AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION; BKNG (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Note major-cap divergences: MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) RECOVERY and TSLA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -4.95%) RECOVERY — this qualifies as a MAJOR divergence, so tread cautiously.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure with net negative 1W returns (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -7.85%). Key names: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND; sector internals mixed and short-term risk remains elevated.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak on the week (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -2.29%) with headline bank underperformance. Key names: BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION, C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND; limited breadth argues for caution on broad exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed to slightly negative on the week (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +1.00%) with pockets of strength. JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND anchor the sector while LLY (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND shows selective risk.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Real Estate and Utilities exposure given leadership and above-trend moves (EQIX, AMT, EXC). Reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and broad Financials until divergences resolve; style mixed / no clear leadership between Growth and Value.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND on positive news (+80) confirming price action; TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND on strong results (+75). BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND with negative sentiment (-60) confirming weakness; AMZN (1W: -5.48% | 1M: -16.00%) BELOW TREND remains at risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (one of the top performers) and Utilities (both ABOVE TREND) as potential safe-haven leadership. BEARISH: Technology and Financials given clustered BELOW TREND names and headline-driven volatility.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND for a decisive break above short-term resistance to signal stabilization. Monitor AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND for continued distribution; a failure to recover near-term support would deepen tech weakness. Track JPM/C bank group sentiment for spillover into Financials versus Real Estate resilience.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+80): Applied Materials clears export probe and deepens Samsung AI ties; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) — sentiment confirmed by strong price. TMUS (+75): strong results and large capital return; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) — confirming accumulation. EL (+60): raised guidance; price RECOVERY (1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%) — sentiment may be driving a short-term reversal.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-60): FTC scrutiny and Siri delays headline; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) — sentiment confirming outflow. AMZN (-50): seller-payment headlines with price BELOW TREND (1W: -5.48% | 1M: -16.00%) — confirming pressure. CCI (-50): bearish take on fiber sale and guidance, but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) — clear divergence to watch.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership amid narrow Real Estate-led gains. EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND and AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND and major-cap divergences (MSFT, UNH, TSLA RECOVERY) present key risks to monitor, especially versus bullish news names like AMAT where price confirms sentiment.
